confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, extrapolated to July 2026. Not checked against live menus, listings or booking sites; no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and hostel anchors are the most grounded. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (about 3.5 to 4 times beer) because direct knowledge of current bar prices is limited. The 3-star hotel anchor is the least certain given property variation and July low season. FX came from RBA search results; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Southeast Asian capital and tourist-city price levels with USD-dollarized pricing, using Siem Reap and Vientiane as regional reference points and adjusting for Phnom Penh's capital-city restaurant and cafe pricing. No listing-level comparison was made.
